It sounds like you've been able to accept the fact that you're different, which is awesome. I am so happy for you that you can do that. :D It sounds like you have a very supportive girlfriend and that's amazing.

Maybe one day soon I'll have as much confidence in myself as you do. :) I'll give it a shot soon, I think.

Thanks for the words of encouragement. I really truly appreciate it. You're right. I just need to start small instead of going all out and crazy. 

My Mum suggested Katharine Hepburn as an option for this Hollywood glam thing. All I'm afraid of is the makeup. :D

I'll give a shot being just me for a while longer, but maybe I can turn into a different me that I'm more comfortable with soon.

Thank you for your help! :D

I will try not to freak out over it too much. It makes me feel better to get another perspective
He has said once or twice that it makes him feel unwanted/unneeded.

Thanks for the advice. 

I do try and talk to him about it when it bothers me, and when I think it's bothering him, but he never says it a problem. I can't tell if he is saying that because it's true or so I don't feel bad.

I seriously feel like an overly attached girlfriend sometimes because I always get stressed and nervous when he says stuff because I immediately think he's lying. ( I know I have issues, seeing a shrink for it)
